page.layout: One column of running text, full measure. No marginal notes. Page number at top left, running head at top right. Catchword at right below the last line.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: esset : tum enim hæreditas tota in duas
partes pares dividebatur. Nec aliud in pu-
beris defuncti bonis valebat. Sed avuncu-
lum & patruum, item materteram&ami-
tam altero tantùm parente conjunctos
cum parentibus defuncti avus & avia à
successione ejusmodi excludebant. Uteri-
ni & consanguinei fratres, item sorores, si
patrui, avunculi, amitæ, materteræ non
essent, succedebant sibi mutuò, exclusis
patruis, avunculis, amitis, materteris ma-
gnis. Privignus ex vitrico aut novercâ ge-
nitus sorores habens uterinas vel consan-
guineas à morte matris aut patris sui te-
nebatur cum vitrico aut novercâ eas alere,
elocare,dotare. Quod si in matrimonio se-
cundo filii quoque geniti essent, hos quo-
que oportebat cum fratre ex priore matri-
monio orto, & cum patre, idem sororibus
suis germanis præstare. Sed pleraque ho-
rum correcta nunc jure novo. Id sic ha-
bet. Liberi parentum suorum hæredes
sunto sine discrimine sexus in mobilibus
pariter & immobilibus: verùm filius du-
plum semper capito, soror simplû. Fratres
& sorores præferuntor parentibus in bonis

page.notes: Catchword "defuncti" printed at right below the last line. Page opens with a fragment ("esset"), so the paragraph continues from the previous page. Printed "præferuntor" and "simplû." kept as printed; the macron on "simplû" is doubtful. Running head "Frif." kept as printed. The grey digitiser mark at the lower right was left out.
